system.description:
HUMAN

Human cultures borrow, adapt and reinterpret belief with the same restless energy they apply to everything else.
During your daily preparations, select one religion, Divine Aspect or recognised spiritual tradition that you have previously encountered.
Until your next daily preparations, you gain a +2-racial bonus to Observe Sacred Custom and Recognise Doctrine checks concerning that tradition.
If you possess no ranks in the skill normally required for either action, you may treat yourself as possessing 1 rank in that skill for the purpose of using that action against the selected tradition only.

Use at daily preparation: name the tradition — +2 racial is then pre-ticked on Observe Sacred Custom and Recognise Doctrine with that name beside it, and the 1-rank waiver applies.
